BSC29-001.name: The FortyFourthMachine Glorious-Racoon
BSC29-001.effect:
Main - [Accel: Cost 4 ([White Core][White Core])]
You can reveal three cards from your decktop. Among them, add an "Imagine" family Brave card and a "God-King"/"Ten Crown" family Spirit card to the Hand. Discard any remaining cards. After this effect resolves, put this card face-up onto the Removed Zone.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
When summoned from the Removed Zone, you can summon an "Imagine" family Brave card from your Hand, without paying the cost.

BSC29-023.name: A Keen and Clear Conquest!!
BSC29-023.effect:
When only the opposing Spirit is destroyed by comparing BP with your Green Spirit, return this Magic card from the Trash to your Hand.

[Flash]
Return an opposing exhausted Spirit/Ultimate to the Hand.

BSC29-019.name: Beloved Person
BSC29-019.effect:
[Main]
Draw two cards. Or, summon a Cost 3 or less Spirit card from your Trash without paying the cost.

[Flash]
During this turn, give a Spirit +3000 BP.

BSC29-028.name: Blue Impact
BSC29-028.effect:
[Main]
Destroy an opposing Spirit/Ultimate with the lowest cost. If you control any [The GiantEmperor Alexander], also, you can deploy up to three Nexus cards from your Trash without paying the cost.

[Flash]
During this turn, give a Spirit +3000 BP.

BSC29-015.name: Crimson Strike
BSC29-015.effect:
[Main]
During this turn, give one of your Spirits +10000 BP and "[True-Clash] (When Attacks) Opposing Spirits/Ultimates must block if possible." If you control any "Wurm"-named Spirit, also, draw two cards.

[Flash]
During this turn, give a Spirit +3000 BP.

BSC29-005.name: Daybreak
BSC29-005.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your Attack Step)
Your "Galaxian" family Spirits can target and attack an opposing Spirit/Ultimate.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When only the opposing Spirit is destroyed by comparing BP with your [The ShineCentaurusDeity Sagitto-Apollodragon], for each of your braved Braves, send an opposing Life to the Reserve.

BSC29-022.name: Emerald Breath
BSC29-022.effect:
[Flash]
Exhaust an opposing Spirit. Then, if you control any [The BladeKingBeast Byak-Garo], return every opposing exhausted Spirit/Ultimate to the Hand.

BSC29-007.name: His Cards
BSC29-007.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your Main Step)
When your "Wurm"-named Spirit is summoned, you can draw two cards.

[LV2] (Your Draw Step)
Instead of drawing, you can reveal three cards from your decktop. Add one card among them to your Hand. Return the remaining cards to the decktop in any order.

BSC29-006.name: Nothing Ventured, Nothing Gained
BSC29-006.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your Attack Step)
Your Spirits can target and attack an opposing 10000 BP or more Spirit/Ultimate.

[LV2] (Opposing Attack Step)
When your Life is reduced by the opponent, destroy an opposing 7000 BP or less Spirit.

BSC29-024.name: Parental Bond
BSC29-024.effect:
[Flash]
When this battle ends, end the Attack Step. If you control any [The SheepTwelveGodKing Glorious-Sheep], instead, when this battle ends, end the Attack Step, and put a core from the Void to your Life.

BSC29-012.name: Professor Battle Usagi's BS Course!
BSC29-012.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your Draw Step)
At the start of the step, by discarding a Yellow Spirit card from your Hand, increase the number of cards you draw by +1.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When your Yellow Spirits are destroyed by the opponent, by discarding a Magic card from your Hand, one of those destroyed Spirits remains on the Field , exhausted.

BSC29-021.name: Rabbit-Usagi's Trial
BSC29-021.effect:
[Flash]
During this turn, when summoning a Spirit card with a "High Speed"/"Swift"-named effect from your Hand, you can change its Cost to 4. This effect can't be used during the Main Step.

BSC29-029.name: Revelation
BSC29-029.effect:
[Main]
Reveal five cards from your decktop. Add a "TwelveGodKing"-named Spirit card among them to the Hand. Return any remaining cards to the deckbottom in any order.

[Flash]
During this turn, give a Spirit +2000 BP.

BSC29-017.name: Rising Sun
BSC29-017.effect:
[Flash]
Destroy any number of opposing Spirits up to a total of 5000 BP. Or, destroy an opposing Nexus. If you control any "Apollo"-named Spirit/Ultimate, instead, destroy any number of opposing Spirits up to a total of 10000 BP, and destroy an opposing Nexus.

BSC29-026.name: Subtract Points
BSC29-026.effect:
[Flash]
During this turn, give an opposing Spirit/Ultimate -2000 BP. A Spirit/Ultimate whose BP was brought to 0 by this effect is returned to the Hand.

BSC29-010.name: The Beginning Card
BSC29-010.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
When your [The RoosterTwelveGodKing Gale-Phoenix] is summoned, put three cores from the Void to any of your Spirits.

[LV2] (Either Attack Step)
While your [The RoosterTwelveGodKing Gale-Phoenix] is battling, opposing Bursts can't activate.

BSC29-011.name: The Distressing Decision
BSC29-011.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your Draw Step)
Instead of drawing, you can return an opposing Burst to the Hand.

[LV2] (Either Attack Step)
When only the opposing Spirit is destroyed by comparing BP with your Green Spirit, put a core from the Void to any of your Spirits.

BSC29-002.name: The FiftySeventhMonkeyMaster Onkot-Merlin
BSC29-002.effect:
Main- [Accel: Cost 4 ([Yellow Core][Yellow Core])]
You can reveal three cards from your decktop. Among them, add an "Imagine" family Brave card and a "God-King"/"Ten Crown" family Spirit card to the Hand. Discard any remaining cards. After this effect resolves, put this card face-up onto the Removed Zone.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
When summoned from the Removed Zone, you can summon an "Imagine" family Brave card from your Hand, without paying the cost.

BSC29-014.name: The God-King Clock Tower
BSC29-014.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
When summoning your "TwelveGodKing"-named Spirit, choose one color among Red/Purple/Green/White/Yellow/Blue, and make this Nexus' symbols become two of that color.

[During Seal] [LV2]
All your "TwelveGodKing"-named Spirits gain +5000 BP.

BSC29-009.name: The Light and Dark Sacred Sword
BSC29-009.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
When an opposing Spirit braves, exhaust that Brave Spirit.

[LV2]
When your Brave Spirit is destroyed by the opponent, separate the destroyed Spirit and return it to the Hand.

BSC29-004.name: The Mogami Family's Dinner
BSC29-004.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
When your Spirits are destroyed, destroy an opposing Nexus.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When your Spirit attacks, destroy an opposing "Crab"-named Spirit.

BSC29-008.name: The Purple Talk
BSC29-008.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When your Cost 5 or more Purple Spirits attack, send a core from any opposing Spirits to their Reserve.

[LV2] (Your End Step)
Draw a card.

BSC29-003.name: The SixtiethKid Calamity-Uri
BSC29-003.effect:
Main - [Accel: Cost 4 ([Blue Core][Blue Core])]
You can reveal three cards from your decktop. Among them, add an "Imagine" family Brave card and a "God-King"/"Ten Crown" family Spirit card to the Hand. Discard any remaining cards. After this effect resolves, put this card face-up onto the Removed Zone.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
When summoned from the Removed Zone, you can summon an "Imagine" family Brave card from your Hand, without paying the cost.

BSC29-013.name: The Ultimate Power
BSC29-013.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Opposing Attack Step)
When your Life is reduced by the opponent, you can reveal a card from your decktop. If that card is an Ultimate card, add it to the Hand. Discard it if it's any other card.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When your Ultimate attacks, destroy an opposing 5000 BP or less Spirit.

BSC29-016.name: V-V-Victory!!
BSC29-016.effect:
When only the opposing Spirit is destroyed by comparing BP with your Red Spirit, return this Magic card from the Trash to your Hand.

[Flash]
Destroy two opposing 4000 BP or less Spirits.

BSC29-020.name: Violet Needle
BSC29-020.effect:
[Flash]
Destroy an opposing exhausted Cost 6 or less Spirit/Ultimate. If you control any "SevenShogun"-named Spirit, also, send a core each from every opposing Spirit/Ultimate to their Reserve.

BSC29-025.name: White Return
BSC29-025.effect:
[Flash]
Return an opposing Spirit to the Hand. Or, exhaust an opposing Spirit. Then, if your control any exactly-named "The DoomKnightLord Ragna-Rock", refresh all your Spirits, and exhaust every opposing Spirit.

BSC29-027.name: Yellow Hold
BSC29-027.effect:
If you control any "GreatAngelia"-named Spirit, the cost of this Magic card in Hand/Removed Zone becomes Cost 3.

[Flash]
Target an opposing Spirit/Ultimate. During this turn, that Spirit/Ultimate can't attack/block.
